Description: LT: Packages | Ability to record Pallet Spaces
NoteText:
Ability to record Pallet Spaces

There is currently no ability for a user to record the number of pallet spaces required for cargo/freight within the Packages grid.

Pallet spaces are used for irregular sized freight rather than standard pallets.

Transport Companies use Pallet spaces for allocations to vehicles/trailers etc
Transport Companies also use Pallet spaces as a method of billing (e.g. $100 per pallet space)

Therefore we need to have a NEW column in the Packages Grid - Pallet Spaces that allows for this information to be captured, and then used as a Billing / Costing method for calculating Revenue and Costs

Need ability to have Totals
 - total pallet spaces as a summary 

USE SAME LOGIC AS DEFINED
 - we can have a total pallet spaces / declared pallet spaces
